_comment: A stand-in for the feedback context endpoint serving F4, for looking at Build C without n8n. Point VITE_FEEDBACK_CONTEXT_URL at /feedback-context-new-hire-readiness.sample.json and any token-shaped ?t= on /feedback/new-hire-readiness opens it. Everything here is invented: there is no manager called Peter Njoroge and no employee called Grace Wanjiru.
_prefill: TWO names, and the distinction matters: fullName is the line manager filling this in, subjectName is the new hire being reviewed. reviewPoint is 'Month 1' or 'Month 3' — the same manager gets this form twice about the same person, and it is the only thing that keeps the two responses apart.
